chapters.title: Chapter 401: The atmosphere gradually solidified
paragraphs: "Master City Lord! Master Wu Ma Tao and Master Takayama Tetsu are here!"
A Martial Emperor said respectfully through the curtain of the small hall.
"Quickly invite two adults to come in, no, I will greet you!"
Nan Men Shang immediately stood up and opened the curtain.
The Emperor Wu's subordinate left wittily, revealing Wu Ma Tao and Gao Shan Che behind him.
"Haha!"
Nanmenshang laughed and said, "The presence of the two adults really makes me splendid!"
"Haha, disturb the Lord City Lord."
Wu Ma Tao and Gao Shan cheered back with a smile.
Nanmenshang hurriedly waved his hand: "What is the Lord of the City? How do I qualify to be called an adult?"
"Haha, in any case, Daoist Nanmenshang is the master of a city, why not?"
Wuma Tao smiled, then seemed to glance at Su Lang inadvertently, and said in surprise, "Hey, this Dao is friendly and strange."
"City Lord Nanmenshang, who is this fellow Taoist?"
Takayama Toru also looked at Nanmenshang with some doubts.
At the same time, he was also observing Su Lang, but found that he could not see through.
It can only be found that the body surface of this strange young strong man is covered with a layer of powerful mental power of the sea of mind.
Other than that, there was no breath.
This made Takayama Toru a little shocked immediately.
You must know that he has been fighting for a long time, and his sensitivity to breath has reached a very exaggerated level.
But when I got to Su Lang's side, I couldn't feel it at all.
This made him feel uneasy in the face of the unknown.
"Haha, let me introduce it!

Nanmenshang said with a smile on his face, "This is a fellow Youtian Daoist who has just returned from a foreign race. He has a high level of cultivation, and his formation is unpredictable and hard to measure!"
"The city owner praised it."
Su Lang smiled faintly.
"Why!"
Nanmenshang laughed and said, "I'm telling the truth!"
As soon as these words came out, Takayama Toru and Wuma Tao suddenly appeared surprised.
They did not expect that Nanmenshang would have such a high evaluation of this Youtian!
In particular, in front of the famous formation master Wuma Tao, he even said that Youtian Formation Dao was unpredictable.
This is intriguing.
"Friend You Tian, I'll introduce these two to you."
At this time, Nanmenshang said, "This is the well-known Daoist Wu Ma Tao in the clan.
This is one of the main city guard leaders, fellow Taoist Toru Takayama who is victorious in all battles! "
"I just have a false name."
"It's hard to talk about winning every battle!"
Wuma Tao and Takayama Toru said modestly at the same time.
Among them, Gaoshan Che was really humble, and Wuma Tao was humble on the surface, but the thought of competing with Su Lang arose in his heart.
"Come on, everyone sit down and talk."
At Nanmenshang's invitation, the four people sat down around the short group.
"City Lord Nanmenshang, Daoist Youtian went to a foreign land to travel, and I will talk to you when I come back. The friendship is not shallow.
Wuma Tao said, "But you are also familiar with me. Why didn't you introduce Daoyou Youtian to me before?"
As soon as he said this, Takayama Toru also pricked his ears.
However, where did Nanmenshang and Su Lang make friends? It hasn't been long since they talked!
Therefore, he can only look at Su Lang.
"In fact, I have just met Nanmen Shang Daoyou not long ago."
Su Lang smiled, "I just came back from a foreign land, just when I found something, I came to the city lord."
Takayama Toru immediately came to the spirit: "Oh!? Found something? Is it about the alien?"
"No."
Su Lang shook his head, "It's about the Blue Wind City defensive formation."
As soon as this statement was made, the atmosphere instantly solidified.
Gao Shan looked at Su Lang in surprise, and didn't know how to answer the conversation.
Wuma Tao, who had a desire to compete with Su Lang, squinted even more.
Wuma Tao paused, and said, "This Blue Wind City formation is exactly what I set up. I wonder if Fellow Youtian has discovered?"
"I found a flaw in the defense formation."
Su Lang is straightforward, and he is not afraid to offend Wuma Tao, anyway, the Human Fengling Clan is the enemy.
"What? You found a flaw in the formation of Blue Wind City?"
Wuma Tao's face became a little ugly in an instant, but immediately returned to normal.
He said: "To be honest, my formation does have two flaws. I came to Qingfeng City this time because of this.
Fellow Daoist Youtian could discover a flaw in my formation, and the formation was impressive. "

chapters.title: Chapter 402: Angry Wuma Tao
paragraphs: This is a bit of gunpowder.
Wuma Tao said that there were two flaws in his formation, but Su Lang only saw one, saying that he admired it, but it was contemptuous!
Seeing that Wuma Tao was unhappy, Gao Shan looked towards Nanmenshang, but found that Nanmenshang had nothing to say.
At this time, shouldn't we come out to make a round?
But Nanmenshang seemed to turn a deaf ear, drinking tea to himself.
At this time.
"Friend of Taoist Wuma Tao is afraid of misunderstanding."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I found more than one flaw, but twelve. If you investigate carefully, there will be more."
As soon as this statement was made, the expressions of the other three suddenly changed.
Nanmenshang knew it would happen, so his eyes flashed.
After hearing Su Lang's words, Gao Shan completely looked at Wuma Tao with surprise on his face.
But seeing Wuma Tao's eyes widened, in disbelief, his face turned red and blue veins looming.
The atmosphere is almost freezing!
"Friend You Tian! You can eat rice but you can't talk nonsense!"
Wuma Tao took a deep breath, and said with a gloomy expression, "I know all about the formations I set up, twelve flaws? Maybe more? It's just nonsense!"
Wuma Tao is a rare formation statue of the Fengling tribe.
Over the years, he has arranged formations for many cities and has been supported by many strong people.
When questioned in other respects, he might listen.
But it was the first time that it was questioned above the battlefield.
Coupled with the previously hidden hostility, Wuma Tao immediately lost his temper!
"What I said is true."
Su Lang picked up the teacup and took a sip.
"fart!"
"I am one of the few array masters of the Fengling Clan. Can your array skills match me?"
Wuma Tao was completely angry. He roared with blood-red eyes, "Why do you have the right to comment on my formation?"
"Formation attainments?"
"My formation skills may be higher than yours, but I dare not say how advanced my formation skills are."
Su Lang smiled indifferently: "Because I was studying formation in a foreign land, and I have seen too many strong people with great formations."
The faint smile was full of irony.
The implication is to scold Wuma Tao for sitting on the well and watching the sky, not knowing how high the sky is!
"you!"
Wuma Tao pointed at Su Lang, his fingers trembling.
Unbelievably, he, who is respected by the wind spirit clan, was actually insulted face to face.
This is really a shame!
Wuma Tao stared at Su Lang, fierce gaze spurted from his eyes.
At this moment, he really wished to smash the Youtian corpse in front of him immediately!
"Friend of Taoist Wuma Tao.
"Since I told you about the flaws in the formation, it means that I am very sure."
Su Lang said calmly, "If you don't want to believe it, let's go and see the formation together."
His words were very sincere, but when he heard Wu Ma Tao's ears, he was full of provocations!
"Youtian, since you are so sure, then I will let you find it!"
"I want to see how you can find so many flaws in my formation!"
Wuma Tao's red tendons exploded, and his voice was a little hysterical.
Su Lang smiled and said, "If you find out, how?"
Wuma Tao asked sharply, "If I can't find it, what about!!!?"
There seems to be explosive powder floating in the air, and the whole small hall will explode in the next moment!
"If you can't find it."
"These four perfect quality Taiyi Tianxin Pills belong to you."
Su Lang smiled faintly, stretched out his hand, and suddenly four perfect quality Taiyi Tianxin Pills appeared on Xiaoji.
"what!!"
"The perfect quality Taiyi Tianxin Pill!"
As soon as Su Lang's medicine was released, Nanmenshang and Gaoshan Che looked straight.
Wuma Tao's angry expression also immediately solidified, and there was a touch of greed in his eyes!
Taiyi Tianxin Pill!
This is a noble spiritual pill, and among the same level of pill, it is considered top.
Even the ordinary Taiyi Tianxin Pill can make Wu Zun powerhouse show greed, let alone perfect quality!

chapters.title: Chapter 403: No one can go back
paragraphs: This Taiyi Tianxin Pill was made with the materials given by Rupert.
One of them will be returned to Rupert, and four will belong to Su Lang.
Originally, Su Lang intended to take it, but considering that he might not be able to push his mental power to the realm of Morning Star in one go, he stayed and prepared to take it later.
At this moment, taking out this extremely precious Taiyi Tianxin Pill as a bet, Su Lang wanted to make a fortune from Wuma Tao.
This professional refining fellow must have a lot of refining materials.
"Friend of Taoist Wuma Tao."
Su "What if I found so many flaws?"
Looking at the stunned three people, Su Lang's mouth twitched, revealing a slight smile.
"I don't have anything long, except for spirit stones, I have also accumulated some refining materials."
Wuma Tao recovered, a little ashamed that he hadn't concealed his greed before.
However, he is not afraid of gambling and fighting, and even a little positive.
Because Wuma Tao is very confident in his formation, because his inheritance of formation is god-level!
The defensive formation deployed in Blue Wind City was taken from this god-level formation inheritance.
As a historically tested formation, Wuma Tao didn't believe that Su Lang could find more than twelve flaws!
"The five Taiyi Tianxin Pills, I'm going to make them!"
Wuma Tao thought to himself, and couldn't help feeling a little excited.
Fengling clan is the best at weapon dao, least good at formation dao, and is quite satisfactory in alchemy.
A perfect quality Taiyi Tianxin Pill is very rare, even the Pill God cannot refine it!
"Both spiritual stones and refining materials are fine."
"It would be better if there were advanced refining materials."
Su Lang said noncommitantly, "As long as the value of these four Taiyi Tianxin Pills is about the same."
"Well, a perfect quality Taiyi Tianxin Pill counts as five million top-grade spirit stones!"
Wuma Tao said, "A total of four, that is 20 million high-grade spiritual stones! I will give materials worth 20 million high-grade spiritual stones."
At such a high price, Toru Takayama and Nanmenshang did not surprise them, but showed a look that should be the case.
A five million high-grade spirit stone, the price is five times that of the Sun Jade Pill!
This shows how important this Taiyi Tianxin Pill is in the hearts of Wuma Tao and others.
No wonder Rupert would ask Su Lang to refine this Taiyi Tianxin Pill.
"Then you can take out the materials of 20 million high-grade spirit stones."
Su Lang nodded faintly. Not long ago, he had spent 40 million high-grade spirit stones at a time, leaving 50 million high-grade spirit stones.
Although the 20 million high-grade spirit stones were quite a lot for him, they couldn't make him react much.
"it is good!"
Wuma Tao nodded and agreed, and immediately took out a lot of high-ranking refining materials and some spiritual stones from the storage space.
"These things are indeed worth 20 million high-grade spirit stones."
Su Lang glanced, then withdrew his gaze, only one glance, definitely not much.
With ‘treasure recognition’ he is not afraid of being deceived at all!
Nanmenshang and Gaoshan Chesulang reacted in this way, and suddenly a kind of thing emerged: they are indeed powerful men who have trespassed in alien regions, and they are knowledgeable.
On the other hand, Wuma Tao looked gloomy and secretly scolded Su Lang for pretending.
"With the testimony of Nanmenshang City Lord and Gaoshan Toru, the matter is so set, but no one can go back."
Wuma Tao stood up, flicked his sleeves, and sneered, "Now, please ask Friends of You Tian to find the flaws in my formation!"
With that said, he turned straight and walked outside the small hall.
"Haha, well said, no one can go back!"
Su Lang also stood up and followed with a faint smile.
Takayama Toru and Nanmenshang looked at each other.
Gao Shanchi said in a low voice: "City Lord Nanmenshang, I couldn't say that before, fellow Taoist Wuma Tao..."
"Tru Gaoshan, for the sake of Qingfeng City and the people in the city, I can only offend Daoist Wu Ma Tao."
Nanmen Shang said, "If there are not so many flaws in the Blue Wind City defensive formation, I shall be guilty of Daoist Wu Ma Tao, even if he does not forgive me..."
"You are indeed a good city lord."
Takayama Tetsu shook his head, then nodded, "Let's go, let's go together."
Soon, Nanmenshang and Gaoshan Che also got up and set off, following Su Lang and Wuma Tao.

chapters.title: Chapter 404: Listen carefully!
paragraphs: Wuma Tao left the small hall of the City Lord's Mansion and flew straight to the sky.
Su Lang came to the highest point of the City Lord's Mansion, sat down slowly, took out some spiritual tea, and brewed it on his own.
At this time, Takayama Toru and Nanmenshang also came into the air, looking at Wuma Tao for a while, and Su Lang for a while.
On the street, many warriors of the Fengling tribe found Nanmenshang in the air, and stopped immediately, showing surprise.
"It's Lord City Lord!"
"Why does the Lord of the City fly into the air?"
"Who is the man next to Lord City Lord? Looks so tough!"
"The old man with withered yellow hair is so familiar to me, he seems to have looked up from afar, he must be an incredible figure."
"The one who sits on the roof is amazing. When I grow up, this is the first time I have seen anyone sitting on the roof of the city lord mansion."
"Tsk tsk, to be able to be so casual in front of the city lord, he must be a powerful person of noble rank, maybe his identity is more noble than the lord of the city!"
"Speak carefully! Let's see what the Lord of the City is going to do!"
In a short period of time, almost the entire Fengling Clan warriors of Qingfeng City saw Nanmenshang and Su Lang, and they couldn't help but stop watching.
At this moment, Wuma Tao came under the formation barrier, stretched out his hand a little, and the entire transparent formation barrier suddenly appeared!
I saw countless blue light patterns spread from Wuma Tao's fingertips, forming a mysterious network barrier.
Almost instantly, the sky of the entire Blue Wind City was replaced by a blue barrier.
"This is, the defensive formation is activated!!
"Oh my God, I remembered, this old man is Master Wu Ma Tao from the teleportation formation!"
"It turned out to be him, one of the few formations of our Wind Spirit Clan. It is said that he sponsored the defense formation of our Blue Wind City!"
"Master Wuma Tao came to Qingfeng City to activate the formation today, I am afraid that something big will happen!"
"The big thing? Is it because an enemy is coming to attack the city? Is it a fierce beast or an alien?"
"I can't see it. After all, Lord City Lord did not call the defenders!"
"What exactly is going on?"
There was a lot of noise in Qingfeng City, and countless people were guessing what happened.
And at this moment.
"Youtian!"
"This is the venerable formation that I set up, Lan Ding Huan's Great Formation!"
Wuma Tao's voice spread throughout Qingfeng City, his tone scornful, "You said there are more than twelve flaws in the formation, come up, find out!"
As soon as these words came out, the whole Qingfeng City was silent!
When the wind passed, someone trembled fiercely, with an incredible color in his eyes.
Immediately afterwards, more and more people looked at each other, looking incredible at the sky.
"This is arranged by Master Wuma Tao, who has guarded the Blue Wind City for many years, the Lan Ding Huan Qian Array. Someone even said that there are more than twelve flaws!
"How is this possible? Master Wuma Tao is a well-known formation master of our Fengling Clan. How could there be so many loopholes in the formation!"
"That Youtian must be looking for fault, ridiculous, he dared to oppose Master Wuma Tao."
"That's not right, look at the reaction of the Lord City Lord, he seems to be not helping each other, otherwise there will be no such a scene, that Youtian would have been blasted away long ago!"
"Yeah, can it be that Youtian's formation skills can be compared with Master Wu Ma Tao? This is really amazing!"
Everyone talked, their eyes fell on Su Lang.
At this time.
"Hehe, if you want to find the flaws, I can find them all by sitting here. Why do you have to be close to the formation barrier like you?"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and his faint smile was full of sarcasm.
"Sharp teeth!"
"You should speak with strength!"
Wuma Tao sneered, "If I can't find more than twelve flaws, I will laugh at your Taiyi Tianxin Pill!"
As soon as this statement came out, the Fengling Clan warriors in the city were suddenly in an uproar.
Especially those Wuhuang-level, endless longing rose in their hearts.
A Taiyi Tianxin Pill is enough to make their mental power advance a lot!
"Hmph, I'll take a seat here."
Su Lang shook his head disdainfully, "There are already more than twelve flaws found in a moment, listen carefully!"

paragraphs: "This...this is my formation!?"
"This is impossible, how could my formation have so many flaws!?"
Wuma Tao looked at all directions tremblingly, and the shocking flaws hit his chest like a heavy hammer.
His arrogance, his majesty, and his self-confidence, suddenly shattered! !
At this moment, Su Lang smiled again.
"It's not over yet!"
Su Lang hooked the corner of his mouth and said, "There are still nine flaws, which are caused by the wrong use and matching of formation materials.
These nine kinds of flaws merged into one, covering the entire defensive formation, reducing the power of this great defensive formation out of thin air by a full 30%!
The wrong material is used. This is a low-level error. I believe you will not make such a mistake.
If I'm right, you should not be able to find the materials for these nine formations, so use other materials instead.
It's a pity that you are not at home in the formation, and the substitute materials used are not good. That's why these nine flaws are caused.
Wuma Tao, do you want to hear, which of these nine materials should be used instead? "
When Su Lang said this, Wuma Tao was already speechless, his eyes were staring, his eyes protruding outside, constantly trembling!
"You!! You know the layout and materials needed for this formation!!"
Wuma Tao looked at Su Lang in disbelief, "Otherwise you wouldn't know that I used nine alternative materials.
My formation inheritance has never been leaked, this formation world should only be mastered by me!
You...Who are you? Are you the other descendant of the Thirty Sixth Formation? You are in the same vein with me! ? "
Wuma Tao's words spread throughout Qingfeng City, and everyone looked weird.
"This!"
"Is it true that Daoist Wu Ma Tao and Dao You Tian are brothers?"
Takayama Toru and Nanmenshang looked at each other, their eyes full of doubts.
"No, it's wrong!"
Nanmenshang frowned and said, "If it were brothers, Daoyou Youtian should have known this relationship as soon as he saw this formation..."
"Could it be that Fellow Youtian deliberately did it?" Takayama Toru also frowned.

"Wuma Tao, I can get a feel for your formation!"
"The various functions of the formation correspond to the required materials, as long as there is time, they can be guessed one by one."

Su Lang shook his head and said, "Before I said you were sitting in a well to watch the sky, and you were not convinced, are you convinced now?"

Even if the four characters for the strong are regarded as the most important in the Fengling clan, many low-level warriors can't help showing a good show.

But when he saw the tattered formation barrier above his head, all his emotions suddenly turned into depression.
He lost!
In the field of formation that he is best at, he is defeated! !
"I serve!"
"I'm Wuma Tao, I'm not as good as Daoist Youtian!"
Wuma Tao's eyes closed tightly, a wry smile on his face.
"Haha! If you knew this time, why bother?"
"Wuma Tao, give me your bet, and I won't let you suffer."
"I can tell you the nine correct substitute materials."
Su Lang said indifferently, "As for the ways to make up for the remaining flaws, you must be able to figure out how to make up since you know the existence of the flaws."
"Well, I am willing to listen to Youtian Daoist's opinions on alternative materials."
Wuma Taofei arrived not far from Su Lang and threw a space ring, "This is a bet!"
Su Lang took the ring and put it away with satisfaction after some inspection.

paragraphs: "Thank you two."

Moreover, he was also afraid that Wuma Tao would have hatred in his heart, and he would do his hands and feet in the formation.

At that time, not only will there be no problems in remedying those flaws, but also the control of the formation will be further in your hands. "

"please!"
The three of them returned to the small hall, made a drink, and squirmed slowly, and they started talking while observing Wuma Tao who was busy making up for the formation.

"I have been out for many years in Xia, and only recently passed through the Hengduan Mountains and returned from the area of the Yinjiao tribe."
"I don't know, what major events have happened to our Fengling Clan in recent years?"
Su Lang sipped the drink made by Nanmenshang, knocking on the side.
"A big deal, it really happened!!"
Nanmenshang suddenly became interested, "Youtian Daoist, you don't know, our Fengling clan has a great opportunity!
Because Su Lang helped Nanmenshang so much, Nanmenshang had no defense against Su Lang.
In a word, I clicked on the big secret of the Wind Spirit Clan-Invading Blue Star.
Yes, although it is said that the entire clan invaded Blue Star, this matter is kept secret among the Fengling clan.
Only those in high positions and those involved in the action can know!
The mountain on the side saw the blue star mentioned, and was slightly wary.
Su Lang appeared out of thin air. Although he helped Qingfeng City, Gaoshan Toru never saw through Su Lang, so he was still a little distrustful.
"Our Fengling Clan has a great opportunity!"
Su Lang was surprised, "Rising to our entire ethnic group?"
"It just so happens that I know it too, let me talk about it."
Gao Gao glanced at Nan Menshang and smiled at Su Lang.
Nanmenshang understood, and closed his mouth with a smile. Although both are Wu Zun, Gao Shan Toru is one of the main city guard leaders, and his identity is a little higher than him.
"Good, good."
Su Lang looked at Gaoshan Che enthusiastically.
"In fact, this opportunity is a broken continent."
Gao Shan said with a smile, "As everyone knows, outside of our Canglan Continent, there are many broken continents, also known as continental fragments.
The Broken Continent, as its name suggests, was formed by the fragmentation of a vast world like our Canglan Continent.
They are in the void outside the continent, and the area is many times smaller than the Canglan Continent.
Of course, no matter how small it is, it is larger than the territory of our Fengling tribe, and the resources on it are very rich.
In addition, our Canglan Continent is formed by 3,600 rules to protect the Canglan Continent and maintain the operation of the world.
The Broken Continent has only partially broken rules, far from enough to form a great road.
But it is precisely because of the few rules and lack of checks and balances that the rules of each continent fragment are very active.
The chance of our Fengling Clan was that a time and space crack appeared in the territory, which could lead to a broken continent.
The incomplete rules on this broken continent are very suitable for our Fengling tribe, and have unimaginable benefits for us.
But there are some intelligent beings on that broken continent, human race!
But they are not strong, and now we are planning to invade and occupy that continent fragment.
When the time comes, the territory of our Fengling clan will be equivalent to an instantaneous expansion by many times.
The above rules and resources are enough to make us infinitely useful!
Even the quasi-sage adults of our Fengling clan hope to understand the first rule on that continent fragment and break into the realm of martial sage!
Youtian Taoist Fellow has a high level of cultivation, and if he can go to the mainland fragment to practice, he will definitely be able to break through to the Martial God earlier.
If you are interested, you can follow me back to the main city, and I will help you get the qualification to go to the Broken Continent. "
Gaoshan spoke slowly, Su Lang listened carefully, nodding from time to time.
Nanmenshang on the side flashed his eyes, and said in his heart: "Dao Gaoshan still can't believe in Daoyou Youtian, what he said is three points true, seven points false.
That world... is far from comparable to mainland debris! ! "

paragraphs: About continental debris.
Above the Canglan Continent, any race with a little bit of strength knew it.
The fact that the creatures of the Canglan Continent discovered and occupied mainland fragments was not without precedent, but rather many.
Almost every race that occupies the mainland fragments will usher in explosive growth.
As for the Blue Star, it is actually not a mainland fragment, but a more advanced existence that even Emperor Wu would covet!
The matter was of great importance. Su Lang was originally unidentified. Although he did not show malice, Gaoshan Che still did not dare to leak secrets on such important matters.
However, the existence of the Blue Star is indeed similar to continental debris on the surface.
Therefore, Gaoshan Che simply used the mainland fragments to deceive Su Lang, half true.
Even though Su Lang's identity was really not a problem, he participated in the war and discovered the true secret of Blue Star.
Toru Takayama can also use the grounds of ‘I am humble and I am not qualified to know the truth’.
Or, he simply apologized, and it didn't matter.
After all, he is doing this now, and it is understandable in anyone's eyes.
Even in the eyes of Nanmenshang next to him.
At this time, Gaoshan Che finished talking about the Fengling Clan's ‘chance’, Su Lang fell silent and fell into thought.
"Mainland fragments? Time and space cracks? Human race?"
"Tsao Takayama must be talking about the Blue Star. Could the Blue Star be a continental fragment?"

"If you think about it, it's really possible. The Blue Star itself has martial arts inheritance and is very close to the Canglan Continent. Maybe it was formed after the rest of the continent was broken.
"However, there are still many doubts, and looking at Nanmenshang's expression, Takayama Toru can't believe everything."
Su Lang silently analyzed, leaving a thought in secret.
"Friend Youtian?"
Seeing Su Lang in a trance, Nanmen couldn't help but remind him.
"It turns out to be mainland fragments!"
"That is really a great opportunity for our Fengling Race!"
Su Lang returned to his senses, showing a stunned look, pretending to have a better understanding of mainland fragments.
In fact, he didn't know what continental fragments.
But Takayama Tetsu said that he was ‘well known’, so if Su Lang didn’t pretend to be clear, wouldn’t he be exposed.
"I wonder if Fellow You Tian is interested in this continent fragment?"
Takayama asked with a smile, "It's not long before we will launch a general attack. If we miss this opportunity, the benefits we get will be greatly reduced."
In the eyes of the Fengling Race, the defeat of the Human Race is doomed, and this time is very short.
The Fengling tribe is confident that one attack will wipe out the human race.
The fighting time was short, and the personnel who participated in the fighting later naturally didn't even have much soup.
But Gao Shan Che's words fell in Su Lang's ears, and he immediately moved in his heart.
Su Lang originally thought that the Wind Spirit Clan would not launch a general attack in a short time, he still had time to improve himself, and then slowly take care of the Wind Spirit Clan.
Unexpectedly, it didn't take long for the Wind Spirit Race to launch an invading human race's general offensive!
"This news is too important. We must find an opportunity to send it to Master Lu Bai."
Su Lang thought to himself and smiled on the surface: "Of course there is interest! I just don't know the strength of the human race, the situation of both sides, and the specific total attack time."
The opportunity is rare, so of course Su Lang would like to inquire more about the news.
"The specific total attack time, I don't know."
"This time is decided by the quasi-sage personally, but it's only recently."
"As for the strength of the human race, the situation on both sides? Haha, the human race is inferior to our Fengling race. They only have one warrior, and they are still held by us."
"And our Fengling Clan, there are two Valkyrie who can descend on mainland debris!"
"In addition, there are a large number of Wu Wang Wu Huang Wu Zun strong, human race in front of us, it is like a man's arm."
Takayama laughed loudly, showing his disdain for Human Race.
"Huh? Will only two Valkyrie descend on the mainland fragments?"
Su Lang asked a little strangely, "In addition to Lord Quasi-sage, our Fengling Clan also has six great Valkyrie, are they not going?"
While waiting for Wuma Tao and Gao Shan Che to come over, Su Lang, in Nanmenshang’s conversation, had found out the amount of battle power of the Wind Spirit Race.
At this time, I heard that only two Valkyrie would come to Blue Star, and I was suddenly surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 411: News from Ji Ruxue
paragraphs: "It's not that you don't go, but that there are other important things."
Nanmen Shang opened the mouth and said, "We Fengling Clan's war god, two people descended on the mainland debris, the two maintained the cracks in time and space, and one had important actions."
Su Lang raised his brows and smiled and asked, "There are only five people, and one more?"
"There is one more person."
Nanmenshang's voice was low, "Do you know that fellow Taoist Youtian knows that the of war Tu Qinzheng?"
"I know this!"
Su Lang nodded in his heart and said, "Even, I have seen the Qinghui Baojing and Hanxiang Cangyu Profound Code of Martial God Tu Qinzheng."
Su Lang had seen Tu Qinzheng's attribute panel before and knew that he mastered these two god-level techniques.
"Oh? Youtian Daoist actually knows Martial God Tu Qinzheng so thoroughly?"
Takayama Teru's expression moved, and he was convinced of Su Lang's identity.
"It's not too detailed."
Su Lang pretended to be casual and asked, "I don't know what happened to the Valkyrie Tu Qinzheng, why didn't he participate in such important events?"
"Friend Youtian also knows that there are intelligent beings named Human Race on that continent."
Nanmenshang said, "In the beginning, the space-time cracks were very narrow, and the strong had huge energy and couldn't pass.
We can only send weak warriors and fierce beasts to invade.
At that time, Tu Qinzheng had not broken through the Martial God, and was still in the realm of the Quasi Martial God.
After spending a huge price, our Wind Spirit Clan opened up a temporary passage to allow him to descend on that continent fragment.
Originally, we had great expectations for that battle, but we didn't expect that Human Race also had a quasi-god level.
Therefore, in that battle, Tu Qinzheng did not cause much loss to the human race, and later had to return to Canglan Continent before the temporary passage disappeared.
But before Tu Qin left, he was entangled with a human woman.

Not long ago, Tu Qinzheng, who broke through to the of war, once again descended on the mainland fragments, bringing back two human races and his daughter, a hybrid of the wind spirit race and the human race, Tu Qin was like snow. "
"Tu Qin Ruxue? That is, Ji Ruxue, has she changed to Tu Qin's surname?"
Su Lang thought to himself, "Yes, for Ruxue, the surname Ji represents painful memories..."
At this time, Nanmenshang continued: "Originally, the sons of Martial God Tu Qinzheng were rare. Even if the offspring were mixed with the human race, the rest would not say much.
However, Tu Qinzheng insisted on keeping the human race and absorbing the blood of the human race into the Fengling race, saying that this would give birth to more geniuses.

The Human Race is indeed a race with endless potential. They have had their own Valkyrie in just two thousand years, and their geniuses continue one after another, appearing far more frequently than our Fengling Race.
However, the quasi-sage master and the other Valkyrie never thought of keeping the human race, let alone changing the bloodline of the Fengling race through the human race.
Because... the quasi-sage master and the other war gods believe that the reason why the human race has a higher frequency of genius is because of that... continent fragment.
As long as our Fengling clan lives there for a long time, the frequency of geniuses will increase.
In addition, our Fengling tribe pays attention to purity of blood, and mixed blood is really difficult to be accepted by the public. "
Su Lang pondered: "So, because of the different concepts, Tu Qinzheng had a conflict with the other Valkyrie, so he just quit the burden?"
"It's not just a burden!

Gao Shan shook his head, and then said, "Tu Qinzheng is stubborn and insists on keeping the human race. If the other war gods refuse to allow him, they have to put him under house arrest, which finally triggered a big battle.
Tu Qin was seriously injured, and finally took his daughter Tu Qin Ruxue and others to escape from the territory of the Fengling tribe, without a trace. "
"Nowhere!?"
Su Lang's mouth twitched, and ten thousand grass and mud horses ran wildly in his heart.
He finally found the Canglan Continent, the Fengling Clan, and finally met someone who could inquire about Ji Ruxue.
But I found that the person was gone again...
Nan Menshang nodded and said, "I really don't know where I am!"
"Then, Master Quasi-sage didn't find him?"
Su Lang frowned, "Tu Qin is also the Valkyrie of our race anyway!"
"I've found it. The other five warlords have been there, and there is no news."
Takayama Toru said, "As for the sage quasi-sage, he sits in the main city and can't get away."
"How can you not get out of it?"
Su Lang was surprised, "What is going on?"

sentences.text: "It's not that you don't go, but that there are other important things."

chapters.title: Chapter 416: The main city of the Wind Spirit!
paragraphs: Thinking of this, Su Lang cleared his mind.
First go to the main city of the Fengling clan to take a stroll and maximize your combat power in a short time.
Others, adapt to circumstances!
Therefore, Su Lang first turned the ten clones that were hunting into the appearance of the Wind Spirit Race.
Then they were dispatched to some inaccessible lanes of Qingfeng City.
Immediately afterwards, the avatars dispersed one by one, merged into the crowd, and immediately left Qingfeng City through the teleportation array to go to the various Fengling Clan cities.
When the clone arrived in the new city, it continued to take the teleportation array to the next city.
Ten avatars can take action, and they can set foot in ten cities in ten seconds. In less than half an hour, they can go to all of the more than 1,200 Fengling Clan cities!
And while the clone was secretly expanding the dispatch map, Su Lang and Gao Shan Che were chatting, while checking their own harvest this time.
From Wuma Tao, Su Lang won 13 million high-grade spirit stones and many materials.
Nanmenshang and Gaoshan Toru alone bought more than 30 million high-grade spirit stones, totaling more than 66 million.
In addition to Lingshi, Su Lang also obtained many precious materials.
"One is the lord of a city, and the other is the main city guard leader. Both are local tyrants."
"It's a pity that I still don't have enough high-ranking pills, otherwise I should still earn a lot of spirit stones."
Su Lang licked his lips and immediately ordered all the spirit stones to be stored in the system.
"Ding! All the Lingshi gold coins have been deposited!"
With the notification of the system, the balance of the original high-grade spirit stone of more than 50 million directly rose to more than 134 million!
"Which system should be upgraded with better functions?" Su Lang was a little entangled.
If you upgrade the one-key practice, the current promotion time for the small realm will be shortened to less than 5 hours.
Counting the increase in the promotion time of the small realms, by then, it will be able to promote about three small realms in one day.
If you upgrade one-click martial arts, the time it takes for the Wang-level exercises to reach the Consummation level will be shortened to one and a half days.
The three king-level exercises that are currently being practiced can reach the Consummation level in just one day after counting the previous progress.
At that time, the combat power brought by the three king-level exercises will also be very impressive.
"Well, it's almost the same after all..."
"If this is the case, let's improve the one-key practice first."
After some thinking, Su Lang chose the most basic and most important one-key practice function.
"System, upgrade me the one-key practice function!"
"Ding! The amount of funds consumed to upgrade the system is too large. At present, the unit's ‘high-grade spiritual stone’ has been replaced by the ‘superior spiritual stone."
"Ding! Consume 1 million superb spiritual stones, the one-key training function is upgraded to level 13, and the training speed is increased to 21,824 times the basic speed!"
"It's more than 20,000 times. One day of cultivation is equivalent to 60 years of cultivation for others!"
Su Lang took a deep breath and asked, "System, how long will it take for me to break through to the peak martial arts realm?"
"Ding! Master, it will take you about four hours to break through to the top martial arts commander."
"Four hours, really abnormal speed!" Su Lang exclaimed in his heart.
And at this moment.
Nanmenshang flew up from below: "Two fellow Taoists, I have arranged Qingfeng City, let's set off now!
"it is good!"
Su Lang and Gaoshan Che nodded at the same time.
Immediately afterwards, the three of them went to the teleportation formation together and disappeared in Qingfeng City.
The main city of Fengling tribe.
At this moment, a teleportation array was shining brightly, and the figures of Su Lang's trio appeared.
As soon as he appeared, Su Lang was extremely alert.
If there are strong people around who can see his identity, he will instantly replace him with a clone and escape.
Fortunately, he did not feel anyone spying on himself.
Slightly relieved, Su Lang began to look at the surrounding environment.
This is a hall that is transparent in all directions, and hundreds of teleportation formations have been built in the hall.
There are not many Fengling Clan warriors in the hall, and they are all teleported from outside.
Su Lang didn't see a single person teleporting from the main city.
"The main city is not allowed to enter and not to leave."
"This is all to prevent the human war from escaping."
Gao Shantou looked at Su Lang and said with a smile, "Of course, this is not absolute. As long as the quasi-sage master approves, you can still go out, such as me."

chapters.title: Chapter 417: Nine days Chamber of Commerce, Lan Zheng
paragraphs: "That's it."
Su Lang nodded indifferently, and immediately looked outside.
Standing in the main hall, you can overlook a small area of the main city with a very broad view.
This is the largest city of the Fengling tribe, and it is boundless at a glance.
A huge palace is located in the center of the city, which looks like a giant mountain from a distance.
Nanmenshang’s city lord’s mansion is already very extraordinary, but compared with this palace, the gap is like a small country house and a city mansion.
Surrounding the giant palace, there are rows of exquisite buildings built around, each of which is very beautiful.
The streets are crowded with people and the shops are in full swing, which is a scene of prosperity.
"It's really prosperous!"
Su Lang looked at this Wind Spirit Clan's main city and couldn't help but admire it.
"Of course."
Gao Shan looked into the distance, with a trace of pride on his face, "The Wind Spirits are changing with each passing day, and they will surely become a saint!"
In the Canglan Continent, those with Martial Saints are called Saint Clan, those with Martial Immortals are called Xian Clan, and those with Martial Emperor are Emperor Clan!
Becoming a saint race, among the tens of thousands of intelligent races on the Canglan Continent, it became a middle-to-upper-level race, capable of dominating one side.
"That is inevitable!"
Su Lang laughed, and then said, "Friend Gaoshan Taoist, you said before that there is the largest material supplier of the Fengling Clan, can you take me to see it?"
"Don't go to meet the Valkyrie first?" Takayama Toru asked.
Meet the Valkyrie!
Su Lang's heart burst, his current disguise can't stand the inspection of the Valkyrie!
If he really wanted to meet the Valkyrie first, Su Lang would have to run away!
"Friend Youtian is so anxious, it seems that what you want must be very important."
Nanmen Shang smiled and said, "In that case, let's go and see if there are any treasures you need, and then go to meet the Valkyrie!"
"it is good!"
Takayama nodded thoroughly, "Anyway, it's not in a rush."
"Then trouble fellow Daoshan Gaoshan."
Su Lang smiled slightly and said in his heart: Nanmenshang, you are such a good city lord!
Next, under the leadership of Takayama Toru, the three left the hall and went straight to the street.
The warriors who were originally said to have to go through some inspections.
But Toru Takayama is the leader of the main city guard, and the warriors who are in charge of the inspection are all his subordinates. They are so familiar with them, so they haven't checked.
Su Lang also saved a lot of trouble.
The three of them were fast, and soon came outside a 100-meter-high building.
The building is very exquisite, but there is no lack of magnificent luxury, it looks like a huge treasure!
Yes, this building feels like it is a treasure...
"Looks great!

Gao Shan pointed to the building, haha, "This is the largest material seller of the Fengling Clan, the headquarters of the Nine Heavens Chamber of Commerce, and the things Youtian Daoist Fellow want, there is very likely to be here."
"It just so happens that I also want to purchase some pill materials, please help from Youtian Daoist!"
Nan Menshang's eyes lit up and looked at Su Lang expectantly.
As soon as this remark came out, Gao Shan Che also appeared in a daze, and looked at Su Lang with scorching eyes.
"Haha, as long as the rules are met, my friend will always come!"
Su Lang smiled, "I believe, he is happy to earn a fortune!"
In fact, the ideas of Nanmenshang and Gaoshan Toru were in Su Lang's arms.
Anyway, the two of them bought the materials and asked Su Lang to refine the pill. For every pill refining material, he could earn four spiritual stones for nothing!
This is simply picking up money!
"In that case, it should not be too late, let's go in!"
Takayama said excitedly, "I have already contacted one of the executives of the Chamber of Commerce, Lan Zheng. I have some friendship with him, so I must be able to offer some discounts!"
"We are going to be in the light of fellow Daoist Gaoshan!" Nan Men Shang also smiled.
Soon, the three walked into the headquarters of the Jiutian Chamber of Commerce.
Just a few steps after entering, a Fengling Clan Wuzun greeted him.
This person is wearing a white robe, with a scar on the corner of his left eye, which is covered by a blue tattoo, which looks a strange temperament.
The surrounding staff of the Nine-day Chamber of Commerce looked at him with awe.
Obviously, he is one of the heads of the Nine Heavens Chamber of Commerce, Lan Zheng!

paragraphs: The two eyes faced each other, and the air was quite quiet.
"Is it convenient to talk here?"
Su Lang asked solemnly.
"Of course it's convenient!"
Yan Xingxing's complexion changed, and then a barrier was placed between his hands, "It's more convenient now!"
"Master Yanxingxing!"

Zuoyi, this is an ancient etiquette unique to the Blue Star, which has come back with the prosperity of martial arts civilization.
"who are you?"
Yan Hingxing’s face was full of disbelief, "You really see through my disguise!?"
His disguise is a saint-level inheritance, even the quasi-martial sage of the Fengling clan can't break it.
No one knows his identity, not even the people in the foothold.
However, Wu Zun, the younger generation in front of him, actually saw through his disguise!
This is really incredible!
"My name is Su Lang, this year's Hall of Fame student."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I only came to Canglan Continent a few days ago. I originally wanted to get into the main city of the Fengling Clan to inquire about news, but I didn't expect to meet you!
In fact, I can't see through your disguise, only your true strength and race.
In this main city of the Wind Spirit Race, besides Master Yanxingxing, are there other human races? No!
That's why I am sure, you are Master Yanxingxing! "

After all, without Yanxingxing, the Blue Star human race would have long since perished.
"hiss!!"
After listening to Su Lang's words, Yan Hengxing couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief, "What kind of ability is this to see through the race directly?"
"Innate talent."
Su Lang smiled and said, "Master Yanxingxing, the Fengling clan is about to start the general attack, I wonder what plan you have?"
"What's the plan?"
Yan Hingxing calmed down his shock, his expression a bit bitter, "Once the Fengling Clan launches a general attack, I can only do my best!"
"Desperately..."
Su Lang hesitated to ask, "My lord has the combat power of a high-ranking martial god, facing the saint, how long can he resist?"
"I have a broken high-level defensive soldier, which may be able to withstand Huangfu Qin's tricks.

But it was impossible to escape. I could only rely on the defensive soldiers before the battle began, threatening the lives of the residents of the main city of the Fengling tribe, and confronting Huangfuqin.
In fact, this is a stubborn resistance and a dying struggle. I have almost seen my future fate. "
Yan Xingxing said with a dim expression, "Su Lang, you are one of the best geniuses of our human race.
After the start of the war, Blue Star could not be able to defend it. You protect yourself from your stronghold, and hope that there will be a comeback.
"Master Yanxingxing, you don't have to be so pessimistic!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, revealing a touch of confidence, "I have a way to save Blue Star, save Human Race!"
"what!?"
Yan Hengxing raised his head in astonishment and looked at Su Lang incredulously.
This descendant of Human Race actually said that he can save Blue Star and Human Race?
This is a joke, he can only go to death as a warlord, what can Su Lang do?
Yan Hingxing stared at Su Lang, and suddenly a flash of inspiration: "By the way, you have made a foreign master, do you want to ask a foreign master to take action?
The existence of the suspected Pill Saint will certainly have many Valkyrie to indulge, and if he takes action, it may really relieve our Blue Star's crisis.
However, the temptation of Blue Star is too great, and we can't escape for a while.
Those foreign masters you invited will eventually become the murderers of the Blue Star human race.
However, if we do not invite them to take action, our Blue Star can't even struggle..."
Yan Hengxing finished speaking, then looked at Su Lang with a glimmer of hope.
"That, Master Yanxingxing."
Su Lang's expression was stagnant, and the corners of his mouth twitched, "Actually, the alien pill is myself, I can't invite a foreign of war to help the human race."
Hearing this, Yan Hingxing's face was instantly dull: "What did you say? You are the pill god? How is it possible? Our human race only has Yun Yemeng as a pill god!"

Yan Hingxing’s face was full of disbelief, "You really see through my disguise!?"
His disguise is a saint-level inheritance, even the quasi-martial sage of the Fengling clan can't break it.
No one knows his identity, not even the people in the foothold.
However, Wu Zun, the younger generation in front of him, actually saw through his disguise!
This is really incredible!
"My name is Su Lang, this year's Hall of Fame student."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I only came to Canglan Continent a few days ago.
I originally wanted to get into the main city of the Fengling Clan to inquire about news, but I didn't expect to meet you!
In fact, I can't see through your disguise, only your true strength and race.
In this main city of the Wind Spirit Race, besides Master Yanxingxing, are there other human races?
No!
That's why I am sure, you are Master Yanxingxing!
For Yanxingxing, Su Lang admired it very much, so he used honorifics.
After all, without Yanxingxing, the Blue Star human race would have long since perished.
"hiss!!"
After listening to Su Lang's words, Yan Hengxing couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief, "What kind of ability is this to see through the race directly?"
"Innate talent."
Su Lang smiled and said, "Master Yanxingxing, the Fengling clan is about to start the general attack, I wonder what plan you have?"
"What's the plan?"
Yan Hingxing calmed down his shock, his expression a bit bitter, "Once the Fengling Clan launches a general attack, I can only do my best!"
"Desperately..."
Su Lang hesitated to ask, "My lord has the combat power of a high-ranking martial god, facing the saint, how long can he resist?"
"I have a broken high-level defensive soldier, which may be able to withstand Huangfu Qin's tricks.
But it was impossible to escape.
I could only rely on the defensive soldiers before the battle began, threatening the lives of the residents of the main city of the Fengling tribe, and confronting Huangfuqin.
In fact, this is a stubborn resistance and a dying struggle.
I have almost seen my future fate.
Yan Xingxing said with a dim expression, "Su Lang, you are one of the best geniuses of our human race.
After the start of the war, Blue Star could not be able to defend it.
You protect yourself from your stronghold, and hope that there will be a comeback.
"Master Yanxingxing, you don't have to be so pessimistic!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, revealing a touch of confidence, "I have a way to save Blue Star, save Human Race!"
"what!?"
Yan Hengxing raised his head in astonishment and looked at Su Lang incredulously.
This descendant of Human Race actually said that he can save Blue Star and Human Race?
This is a joke, he can only go to death as a warlord, what can Su Lang do?
Yan Hingxing stared at Su Lang, and suddenly a flash of inspiration: "By the way, you have made a foreign master, do you want to ask a foreign master to take action?
The existence of the suspected Pill Saint will certainly have many Valkyrie to indulge, and if he takes action, it may really relieve our Blue Star's crisis.
However, the temptation of Blue Star is too great, and we can't escape for a while.
Those foreign masters you invited will eventually become the murderers of the Blue Star human race.
However, if we do not invite them to take action, our Blue Star can't even struggle..."
Yan Hengxing finished speaking, then looked at Su Lang with a glimmer of hope.
"That, Master Yanxingxing."
Su Lang's expression was stagnant, and the corners of his mouth twitched, "Actually, the alien pill is myself, I can't invite a foreign of war to help the human race."
Hearing this, Yan Hingxing's face was instantly dull: "What did you say?
You are the pill god?
How is it possible?
Our human race only has Yun Yemeng as a pill god!"

chapters.title: Chapter 422: Tell it all!
paragraphs: "Haha, my alchemy talent is better, so I became a alchemy god."
Su Lang briefly explained, "In order to avoid trouble, I used my clone to pretend to be an alien pill god, disguising my alchemy skills..."
"So that's it..."
Yan Xingxing nodded suddenly, and then said bitterly, "You pretended to be the Alien Pill God, that is to say, there is no foreign aid..."
"Yes, no foreign aid!"
Su Lang nodded and said, "However, in addition to alchemy, I am also good at refining instruments and formations, and I am also very good at practicing and practicing exercises!
Your damaged defensive artifact, as long as the materials are sufficient, I can repair it, and even rise to the top artifact.
In addition, I can see through the formations of the Wind Spirit tribe at a glance. Even the god-level formations can find weaknesses and then use the least strength to defeat them.
In the end, I have an extraordinary savvy and can practice the exercises quickly. You will pass on the Martial Saint inheritance to me, and I will learn it in no time! "
Sulang Balabala said his ‘talent’.
However, Yan Hingxing was shocked again and stiffened all over: "Su Lang, aren't you a super evildoer against the sky in all respects!?
This level of genius, not to mention our human race, even in the Canglan Continent, it is forever! "
"But what I said is true!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "Do you know what I want to do with Heaven and Earth Ghost Bones and Soul Shard Moshuang? I want to refine an artifact!"
"Pill God, Tool God, Formation God!"
Yan Hingxing's eyes widened, "Su Lang, you are really amazing, but these abilities cannot be transformed into combat power in a short time!"
"Yes!
Su Lang looked serious: "Give me enough materials and I will be able to refine a large number of pills, allowing you to break through to a higher level in a short time!
And I can refine a lot of artifacts for you, so that you can compete with Huangfuqin!
In addition to other formations, I can find out the weaknesses of the wind spirit clan formations and destroy them!
On the other side of the time and space cracks, if the Wind Spirits want to invade the Blue Star, they will definitely use the formation method to expand the time and space cracks.
As long as I destroy those formations, I can turn the cracks in time and space into a dead end.
All the Wind Spirit Races who are in the cracks of time and space, no matter how high their cultivation level, will tragically die in the turbulence of time and space!
With these methods alone, we can compete with the Wind Spirits!
But in fact, our human race has two war powers, and the other is me! "
Yan Hingxing was dumbfounded, as if he was in an endless thunder and lightning, trembling and numb all over, even his consciousness seemed to disappear!
"The premise of all this is that you give me enough resources!"
Su Lang took a deep breath, "I need countless spirit stones, countless alchemy materials, the higher the level, the better!"
"The Wind Spirit Race is about to attack!"
Yan Hingxing was fiercely excited, "Su Lang, how long are you talking about?"
"One day!" Su Lang replied.
"one day!!
"This...how is this enough?"
Yan Hengxing tremblingly said, "It takes more than a day to refine a furnace of God-level pill!"
Su Lang smiled mysteriously: "My inheritance is different. Master Yanxingxing only looks at the results."

As soon as this remark came out, Yan Hengxing thought for a while and nodded: "Everyone has a secret, and the same is true for myself. Since you said it, then I only look at the results, not the process."
Su Lang smiled and said, "For Master Yanxingxing, I am very relieved, and please don't worry about me running away."
"Haha, I can rest assured!"
Yan Hingxing nodded his head, "I will give you part of what you need now!"
As he said, Yanxingxing stretched out his hand and shook, a large number of Lingshi Lingyu appeared in front of Su Lang, the Lingshi piled up into a hill, and there were tens of thousands of Lingshi!
Among them are not only low-grade spirit jade, but also middle-grade spirit jade, and even high-grade spirit jade!
In sum, the total of these spirit stones and jade given by Yanxingxing is more than 300 million top-grade spirit jade!
In addition, there are many alchemy materials, including a large number of honor-level materials and god-level materials.
Immediately, Yan Hingxing stretched out his hand and a heart-guard flew out from his chest and fell in front of Su Lang.
This heart-guard is the advanced defensive artifact in the mouth of Yanxingxing.
In the end, he took out a lot of jade slips for the exercises, one by one, just looking at the appearance, they are very extraordinary, they are the holy and god-level exercises!
It can be said that Yan Hengxing has taken out all his wealth!

chapters.title: Chapter 423: Raid!
paragraphs: "These things are basically obtained from the inheritance of that Martial Saint."

Yan Hingxing said solemnly: "Besides, I can also give you things from the Nine Heavens Chamber of Commerce. Anyway, the Wind Spirit Race is about to go to war, and I won't be able to hide my identity for long."
"Thank you, Master Yanxingxing!"
Su Lang nodded very excitedly, and then put everything into the storage space.
"Go! I'll take you to the Chamber of Commerce secret library!"
Yan Hingxing stood up and walked straight out, Su Lang quickly followed.
Because Lan Zheng, who Yanxingxing disguised as one of the heads of the Jiutian Chamber of Commerce, went all the way unimpeded and soon arrived at the building where the secret library was located.
Entering the building, there are all warehouses and secret warehouses!
Because of receiving an order from Yanxingxing, there was no one here at this time.

"The other persons in charge of the Nine Heavens Chamber of Commerce have long been controlled by me using the puppet secret method. I have all the permissions for the warehouse secret library here. You can take it whatever you want!"
Yan Xingxing waved his hand, and the doors of dozens of hundreds of secret libraries were all opened. Lingshi, jade, and countless materials were instantly displayed before his eyes.
"Fuck! The secret library of the largest material supplier of the Fengling Clan, this is well developed!"
Su Lang's eyes gleamed with excitement, and then rushed up and searched, not letting go of the spirit stone materials, no matter the high or low level!
In a blink of an eye, the secret library that was full of Dangdang became empty, and several doors were shaken by the wind brought up by Su Lang's running, which was quite desolate.
"Su Lang...you took all this!?"
Yan Xingxing's mouth twitched, "What do we sell in the Chamber of Commerce in the past two days? Not selling things will definitely arouse suspicion!"
Su Lang chuckled, "Uh, then I should go back a little bit?
"Oh, forget it!"
Yan Hengxing smiled bitterly and shook his head, "I'll let the people below hurry up and buy goods!"
"Oh!? Can you still buy?"
Su Lang's eyes glowed like a light bulb.
"You will use up the materials you have gotten first!"
Yan Hingxing showed a helpless smile, "You don't need to hide your identity anymore, the new materials are yours."
"Ahaha, I just ask casually!"
Su Lang hit a haha and said with a smile: "Then please help me prepare a quiet room, I will help you repair the defensive artifact first."
"That's the most advanced secret library!"
Yan Hingxing nodded and said, "I have to deal with some things, otherwise I will show my feet and I will come to you later!"
Su Lang smiled and said, "Aren't you staring at me?"
"If I can't believe you, would I still give you everything?"
Yan Hingxing rolled his eyes, then turned and left without any muddle.
"Tsk tsk, what kind of earning in Qingfeng City before, now it is really earning!

Su Lang licked his lips, "There are a lot of god-level materials and spirit stones in the martial sage inheritance of Yanxingxing, and the Nine Heavens Chamber of Commerce also has a lot of high-level materials and spirit stones!
With these resources, my strength can instantly increase by many times! "
With uncontrollable excitement, Su Lang entered the high-level secret storehouse and closed the door.
"System, refining all the medicines that can be refined at present!"
"Ding! Successfully refining, you will get the intermediate god-level pill Jiuxiao Tianchen Golden Pill*5!"
"Ding! Successfully refining, you will get the Secret Pill of Seven Lives and Good Fortune of the primary god-rank pill*5!"
"Ding! Successfully refining, you will get a low-level elixir..."
"System, evolve the Youtian Sword and this broken advanced defensive artifact!"
"Ding! Consume Heaven and Earth Ghost Bones*1, Soul Fragment Ink Frost*1, Yinsha Moonlight Stone*2, Promise Fruit*4, Lingxiao Gold*6...The Youtian Sword has evolved into a primary artifact!"
"Ding! Consume Chixiao Breaking Mountain Crystal*2, Yan Luo collapsed Mountain Stone*3, Slashing Sea Xuanbing*1...The Youtian Sword has evolved into an intermediate artifact!"
"Ding! Consume... Youtian Sword has evolved into an advanced artifact!"
"Ding! Consume the Arctic Sublimation Jade*1, Endless Sea Sand*26...The Nine-Different Astrology Realm has evolved into a top-level artifact, repairing all losses!"
"System, use the remaining god-level refining materials to refine me a god-level weapon!"
"Ding! Successful refining! You have obtained the mid-level artifact Wanzhang Bipolar Ruler*1!"
Three artifacts appeared in Su Lang's hands!

chapters.title: Chapter 424: The seventh system function!
paragraphs: The first one, the high-level artifact Youtian sword!
The sword body is still crystal clear white, and the black lines on it condense in the middle, forming a line like a long and narrow black hole!
This striped road possesses a very terrifying soul-destructive power, and it is difficult for ordinary martial emperors to look directly at it, otherwise they will burn their soul!
And when it exerts its true strength, even the mental power of the Martial God Morning Star Realm will be injured!
In addition to a substantial increase in mental lethality.
The Youtian Sword's ability to break defenses has also been greatly enhanced, it can cut a higher level of defense, and it is difficult to destroy by itself!
The second piece, the Nine-Different Astrology Realm, was evolved from the damaged high-level artifact of Yanxing, and it was the best defensive artifact among the top artifacts.
The third piece, the Wanzhang Bipolar Ruler, this artifact has dual attributes of ice and fire, and can expand rapidly, both offensive and defensive!
"Wanzhang Bipolar Ruler and Jiuqi Astrology Realm are handed over to Yanxingxing, presumably he can stop Huangfuqin."
Su Lang put away the Youtian Sword, and then ordered again: "System, deposit all the spirit stones and jade into the balance!"
"Ding! All the Lingshi and Lingyu have been deposited!"
The system prompt came, and the balance that had become the best spirit stone unit directly became more than 14.6 million!
"Hey Hey!"
"Except for one-click training, now all system function upgrades require only 1 million top-grade spirit stones. This time, there will be another wave of upgrades!"
Su Lang couldn't help but let out a deep laugh, and immediately ordered: "The system, first upgrade me the one-key martial arts, clone dispatch function!
"Ding! Consume 1 million superb spirit stones, the one-key martial arts function is increased to level 14, and the training speed is increased to 10,912 times the base speed!"
"Ding! Consume 1 million superb spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 13, the number of clones is +1, and the current number of clones is 13!"
"The number of clones reaches 13!"
"In this way, the increase in combat power brought about by the swallowing clone is even more terrifying!"
"In addition, the speed of one-key martial arts practice has increased, and the three king-level exercises can be completed in just one day."
Su Lang's eyes flickered, "After all this is done, let Yanxingxing go out and do something to delay the opening of the Wind Spirit Race!
As long as I have enough time, I can practice more king-level techniques and push the combat power behind the swallowed clone to the holy level! "
Thinking of this, Su Lang couldn't help but tick the corner of his mouth, revealing a smile.
"Now there are more than 12 million superb spirit stones left!"
"One-key training and one-key training, one is level 15 immediately, and the other is level 10, you will definitely get the access to bonus features and new features!"
"Haha, I don't know what the seventh function is, it's really exciting!"
Su Lang took a deep breath, and then ordered the upgrade of the one-key training function and the one-key training function.
"Ding! Consumes 10 million superb spiritual stones, the one-key training function is upgraded to level 15, and the training speed is increased to 43648 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! Congratulations on raising the one-key training function to level 15. You have obtained the new bonus function "Infinite Cultivation"!"
"Ding! Consume 1 million superb spirit stones, the one-key refining function is upgraded to 10, and it can refining the divine rank and below!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key formation function to level 10, and you have obtained the new bonus function "Array Control"!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key formation function to level 10. You have obtained the activation permission for the new function "One-key synthesis function"!"
As the system prompts came out, a large amount of information was printed into Su Lang's mind, making him instantly understand the effects of the two bonus functions.
The first is the ‘infinite cultivation base’ function, which allows you to continue saving cultivation bases after the sea of cultivation bases is full. There is no upper limit!
So far, this function has no effect on Su Lang.
Secondly, the ‘formation control’ function is awesome. With this ability, you can directly usurp others’ control over the formation!
However, there are limitations.
The formation that can be usurped is one level lower than the highest-level formation that can be refined by the one-key formation function.
In other words, Su Lang is currently able to refine the god-rank formation, then he can control all the noble-rank formations!

Congratulations on upgrading the one-key formation function to level 10, and you have obtained the new bonus function "Array Control"!"
"Ding!
Congratulations on upgrading the one-key formation function to level 10.
You have obtained the activation permission for the new function "One-key synthesis function"!"
As the system prompts came out, a large amount of information was printed into Su Lang's mind, making him instantly understand the effects of the two bonus functions.
The first is the ‘infinite cultivation base’ function, which allows you to continue saving cultivation bases after the sea of cultivation bases is full.
There is no upper limit!
So far, this function has no effect on Su Lang.
Secondly, the ‘formation control’ function is awesome.
With this ability, you can directly usurp others’ control over the formation!
However, there are limitations.
The formation that can be usurped is one level lower than the highest-level formation that can be refined by the one-key formation function.
In other words, Su Lang is currently able to refine the god-rank formation, then he can control all the noble-rank formations!

chapters.title: Chapter 425: One-click synthesis!
paragraphs: "Able to usurp control of the noble formation!"
Su Lang was extremely surprised. When he entered the main city of the Wind Spirit Clan, he had observed the city defense formation before.
The wind spirit clan’s defensive formation is a holy formation, which is sufficient to withstand the attacks of the Wu Sheng-level powerhouse for a certain period of time.
In fact, the strongest formation mage of the Wind Spirit tribe is only God-level, and it is not too strong among the god-level array mage.
The reason why this defensive formation can reach the holy rank is entirely because it is an aggregation formation, also known as a united formation!

This kind of formation is made up of a large number of small formations intertwined, and there are all from the imperial-level formations to the god-level formations, and the number is as many as tens of thousands!
Among them, the most are not the god-level formations, but the lower-level formations, among which the venerable formations occupy most of the positions!
Because the power of the noble-level formation is considerable, and it is not difficult to arrange like the god-level formation, but it is the most favorite formation of the god-level mage.
"The main component of the wind spirit clan's main city protection array is the noble-level array. I can control these arrays!"
"In other words, as long as I want, I can get most of the control of the Wind Spirit Clan's main city formation in a single thought."
"Although the core of this defense formation is still a god-level formation, these god-level formations are closely related to the other formations.
I controlled the rest of the formations, and these god-level formations were considered good if they didn't collapse. "
Su Lang slowly analyzed, a sneer gradually appeared on his face.
"However, it is not yet possible to control the formation, so as not to startle the snake."
"The top priority is to improve your combat power first, but before that, there is still a new system function that has not been activated!
One-click synthesis function, you know that you can synthesize items by listening to the name, but you don't know that it is a perverted function! ? "
With a hint of excitement, Su Lang ordered: "System, activate the one-key synthesis function!"
"Ding! Consume 10 high-grade spirit stones, the one-key synthesis function has been activated!"
"Ding! The current one-key synthesis function is level 1, with a ‘material synthesis’ function, which can be synthesized using the same ordinary grade materials, with a synthesis ratio of 100:1!"
Two system prompts appeared in Su Lang's mind, making him a little confused.
"It can synthesize materials, it's so functional!"
Su Lang frowned: "Just what the is this common grade material?"
The same material is easy to understand, it is the same material.
But at the ordinary level, after thinking about it, Su Lang still couldn't figure out what level it was.
"Forget it, upgrade one level to see the changes!
Su Lang curled his mouth and immediately ordered the upgrade of the one-key synthesis function.

"Ding! Consuming 100 high-grade spirit stones, the one-key synthesis function is upgraded to level 2, and the same body quenching material and the following materials can be used for synthesis! The synthesis ratio is 90:1!"
As soon as this prompt sound came out, Su Lang suddenly understood.
"Level 2 is the body quenching level. It seems that the ordinary level is basically useless to warriors, such as broken stones and wood?"
While thinking about it, Su Lang continued to order the upgrade of the one-key synthesis function.
Anyway, there are still more than 1.6 million best spirit stones without flowers!

"Ding! Consuming 1000 high-grade spirit stones, the one-key synthesis function is upgraded to level 3, and the same martial artist material and the following materials can be used for synthesis! The synthesis ratio is 80:1!"

"Ding! Consuming 10,000 high-grade spirit stones, the one-key synthesis function is upgraded to level 4, and the same martial artist material and the following materials can be used for synthesis! The synthesis ratio is 70:1!"

"Ding! Consume 100,000 high-grade spirit stones, the one-key synthesis function is upgraded to level 5, and the same general material and the following materials can be used for synthesis! The synthesis ratio is 60:1!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key synthesis function to level 5. You have obtained the new function ‘Pill Synthesis’!"
"Ding! Consume 1 million high-grade spirit stones..."
"Ding! Consume 10 million high-grade spirit stones..."

"Ding! Consumes 1 million superb spirit stones, the one-key synthesis function is upgraded to level 8, and the same Wuhuang material and the following materials can be used for synthesis! The synthesis ratio is 30:1!"

chapters.title: Chapter 426: Three-digit noble pill
paragraphs: After a series of system beeps.
Su Lang's balance of the best spirit stone is only a few hundred thousand, and the level of the one-click synthesis function has reached level 8!
The materials that can be used for synthesis have reached the Wuhuang level, which means that Su Lang can synthesize materials of the Wuzun level!
When it reaches level 5, it also comes with a new ‘medicine synthesis’ function!
This function is also extremely important to Su Lang.
It can even be said that sleepiness came to give pillows!
You know, he just wiped out all the secret warehouses of the Jiutian Chamber of Commerce, and the middle and low-level materials accounted for more than 90%!
Because there is a function of ‘a pill in one second’.
So in a short period of time, the one-key alchemy function has refined a large number of low- and middle-level pills for Su Lang.
Coupled with the low- and medium-level pill that was refined before, and the spoils obtained from killing the enemy, Su Lang's low- and medium-level pill was already piled up.
However, these pills were of no use to Su Lang, and he could only sell them later.
And even if you sell it, you can't earn many spirit stones.
After all, the price of middle and low-level pill is there, even if it is tens of thousands of tens of thousands, it will not sell many spirit stones!
And now, with the function of ‘Pill Medicine Synthesis’, these pills can synthesize higher-level pills at a ratio of 30:1, up to the highest level!
Calculated based on the current ratio.
To synthesize a superior-rank pill, you need 30 royal-rank pill or 900 king-rank pill...
When the functions continue to be upgraded and the ratio becomes lower and lower, the low-level pill needed to synthesize a superior-level pill will become less and less, like an avalanche!
"hiss!"
"This feature is absolutely abnormal. No wonder it requires so many spirit stones to activate it!"
Su Lang took a deep breath, then immediately told the system to stop alchemy, and ordered: "System! Give me all the remaining low-level materials to a higher-level synthesis!"
"Ding! Consuming green bamboo*10, synthesizing Liyan bamboo*1!"
"Ding! Consume Liyan Qizhu*10 to synthesize Qiyan Qizhu*1!"
"Ding! Consume King Kong Ice*10 to synthesize Overlord Ice*1!"
"Ding! Consume bipolar dragon silk*10, synthesize Huangji dragon silk*1!"
Numerous system prompts appeared in Su Lang's mind.
Synthesis of ultra-low-level materials, upgrade to low-level materials, and low-level materials continue to be synthesized into higher-level materials!
The piles of materials in the storage space disappeared quickly at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In the blink of an eye, the low-level materials almost disappeared!
Those remaining low-level materials were only able to escape the fate of being synthesized because the quantity was less than 10 copies.
At the end, when all the materials are less than 10 copies, the system prompt stops appearing.
"The synthesis of materials is complete, now you can continue to refine the pill!
"After the pill refining is completed, the low-level pill will be synthesized into the high-level pill, hehehe!"

Su Lang let out a burst of excitement, "Unfortunately, it is impossible to synthesize weapons. Those crafting materials that have been synthesized can only be temporarily stored in the storage space to eat ashes."
After a burst of excitement, Su Lang immediately ordered the synthesis of pill.
As a result, another round of systems continuously appeared!
"Ding! Consume Ruyi Emperor Pill*10, and you will get Taishi Ruyi Zun Pill*1!"
"Ding! Consume..."
In the storage space, the medicinal pill that was just refined disappeared quickly like the previous material.
All low-level medicines are rapidly synthesizing high-level medicines.
Not to mention the emperor-rank king-rank pill and the lower-rank pill, even the number of high-rank pill has exceeded three digits!
You must know that when Su Lang held an auction in the main city of Blue Star, there were only 20 high-ranking pills at that time, which shocked the main city of Blue Star!
And the three-digit noble medicine!
"Tsk, if I sell it, I don’t know how much it can sell!"
"However, let's solve the urgent need first."
"With so many pills, knocking them down will definitely make my cultivation realm soar!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and immediately took out all the medicines above the emperor rank.
